method: Trusted Python stdlib zipfile, no submitted code import or execution. Recursive extraction only beneath owned sources/cache/extracted; nested archives receive .expanded suffix.
format_limits: Other JSON/Markdown/plain-text members were catalogued by name/hash and either scoped static source or quarantined opinion; their bodies were not bulk-displayed. No executable, macro, import, build or replay was run.
timestamp_policy: ZIP member timestamps captured in archive_inventory; extracted filesystem timestamps are acquisition times. Bytes and 0644 permission modes preserved.
